claims: NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) is a super heavy-lift rocket.
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) is an expendable rocket.
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) is designed for deep space missions.
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) is designed for the Artemis program.
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) is the only rocket capable of sending the Orion crew capsule, astronauts, and large cargo directly to the Moon in one launch.
Artemis I flight was successful in 2022.
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) is scheduled for the crewed Artemis II mission in April 2026.
